image_description: A blue, four-wheeled golf cart parked on a paved surface with a beige brick wall in the background. The cart features a cream-colored hardtop roof, a clear windshield, black tubular frame supports, and custom white graphics/decals on the side panels. It has two forward-facing seats with headrests and a rear cargo rack.
